invitation.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete invitation for {{label}}? This also removes all named attendees and cannot be undone.

seating.title: Seating arrangement
seating.noPlans: No seating plans yet. Create one to begin.
seating.deletePlanConfirm: Permanently delete this plan and all its tables and seat assignments?
seating.autoFillConfirm: Auto-fill arranges confirmed guests by household into tables. Use 'clear existing' to start from a blank layout.
seating.autoFillSomeUnseated: {{count}} guests could not be seated — not enough seats.
seating.dragHint: Drag a guest onto a seat. Drop a seated guest here to unseat.
seating.noConfirmedGuests: No confirmed guests yet — confirm RSVPs first.
seating.pinHousehold: click to pin household to top
seating.unseatAllConfirm: Remove every guest from their seat in this plan. The table layout (tables and seat counts) stays the same.

sync.notConnectedHelp: Authorise once to import your guest list from Google Sheets.
sync.modeBody: Choose how to sync. Continue adds new rows and updates existing ones, but never deletes. Clean does the same AND removes guests that are no longer in the sheet, so the app exactly mirrors the sheet.
sync.cleanConfirmTitle: Remove guests missing from the sheet?
sync.cleanConfirmBody: Clean sync makes the app exactly match the sheet: any guest no longer in the sheet is permanently deleted (with their attendees), freeing any seat they held. Matched guests keep their seats. Type DELETE to confirm.
sync.completedClean: Clean sync done — {{inserted}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{renamed}} renamed, {{deleted}} guests removed, {{attendees}} attendees added, {{attendeesRemoved}} attendees removed.
sync.completedCleanWithErrors: Clean sync done with issues — {{inserted}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{renamed}} renamed, {{deleted}} guests removed, {{attendees}} attendees added, {{attendeesRemoved}} attendees removed, {{errorCount}} row(s) failed.
sync.completed: Sync done — {{inserted}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{renamed}} renamed, {{attendees}} attendees.
sync.completedWithErrors: Sync done with issues — {{inserted}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{renamed}} renamed, {{attendees}} attendees, {{errorCount}} row(s) failed.

members.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this client? They will lose all access immediately.
